plugin.name: Better Web Search
plugin.description: Keyless web search and page reading with automatic fallback. Overview, settings and diagnostics keep optional keys separate from normal use. Host search state is read-only; proxies and self-hosted SearXNG are supported.
panel.title: Better Web Search
panel.subtitle: Web search and page reading
panel.guide.keyField.label: Exa key
panel.guide.keyField.help: After saving, the input is cleared and only a masked key is shown. The key is stored in the plugin's config.
panel.guide.urlCopied: Address copied — paste it into your browser bar.
panel.guide.copyFailed: Copy did not work. Select the address above and copy it by hand.
panel.guide.keyEmpty: Paste a key first, or leave it empty and search on the shared free tier.
panel.quota.fallback: Anonymous access needs no key and is subject to shared limits. Account quotas are shown by the provider.
panel.messages.keySaved: Key saved. See Overview for the effective search order.
panel.messages.keySaveFailed: Verification did not succeed. Check the returned reason.
panel.messages.keyRemoveFailed: Delete did not go through. Tap it once more.
panel.messages.testOk: It works, the key is valid.
panel.messages.testFailed: This attempt did not work. Do not change other settings yet.
panel.messages.fallbackFailed: That did not get written. Tap it again.
panel.errors.actionUnavailable: This cannot be clicked right now: start this plugin first (or wait for it to finish starting) and try again.
panel.errors.ssrfFailed: Could not save. Retry or edit net.ssrf_allow_ranges in the config.
panel.errors.refreshFailed: The panel state did not refresh: {detail}
panel.errors.actionRegistryMissing: No actions are visible yet: start this plugin first, then tap "Refresh panel".
panel.confirm.removeMessage: Exa will use anonymous access; other search sources stay unchanged. Clear all Exa keys?
panel.confirm.oneMessage: This only makes the plugin forget {masked}; your Exa account is untouched. Remove it?
panel.confirm.anyMessage: This only makes the plugin forget this key; your AnySearch account is untouched, and searches still work without it (anonymous tier).
panel.exa.title: Exa
panel.key.fallbackLabel: Try keyless once more when every key failed
panel.key.fallbackHelp: Off by default: when the whole pool failed the search goes straight to another backend and saves the time for it. On means one shared anonymous try after the full ring, which is usually gone too.
panel.any.title: AnySearch
panel.any.fieldHelp: After saving, the input is cleared; the panel and plugin status reports show only any****last-4.
panel.any.placeholder: Copy it from the AnySearch console
panel.chain.title: Search order
panel.last.title: Latest search
panel.last.accChain: Which sources did this run through
panel.last.fellBack: "{first}" returned no results. "{backend}" answered this search.
panel.last.meta: At {at} · query {chars} characters · asked for {requested} results
panel.last.help: Only the latest search is kept and a plugin restart clears it. The panel stores the query length, never the query itself.
panel.host.title: Built-in search
panel.host.line: This plugin does not modify the host or take over all of its network features.
panel.host.why: When both search plugins run, conversation may call either one. To prefer this plugin exclusively, you can stop the built-in in the host's Plugin Centre after reviewing the effects below.
panel.host.gate: The host decides whether to dispatch search. Stopping the built-in does not guarantee a search each turn or prevent answers from memory.
panel.host.impact: The current host's window source and topic enrichment still call the built-in search. They may lose material when it is stopped and will not switch to this plugin. Independent meme and music channels are unaffected.
panel.host.tradeoff: After re-enabling, the host gateway may remain in a 5-minute failure cooldown before those paths recover.
panel.host.stopHere: Both plugins are running. Stopping the built-in is optional in the host's Plugin Centre.
panel.diag.title: Network check
panel.diag.scope: The check probes this plugin's own search channels ({chain}) — not the host's built-in search, and not the chat model.
panel.diag.exaWithKey: The exa row uses your saved key ({masked}), so it shows what a keyed request does.
panel.diag.exaAnonymous: Exa uses anonymous access. A failed check does not mean a key is required.
panel.diag.hostUnrelatedOn: The host's built-in search is running, but it takes no part in this check — this plugin does not go through it.
panel.diag.hostUnrelatedOff: The host's built-in search is stopped; that changes nothing in this check.
panel.diag.cost: One live request per source; two with proxy testing enabled.
panel.diag.none: No details came back this time — it may have been too slow, or the plugin was still starting.
panel.diag.emptyResult: The check returned nothing. Try again in a moment.
panel.diag.column.name: Source
panel.diag.dual: Test through the proxy as well
panel.diag.dualAuto: Currently following the detected proxy ({state}). Switch it to decide yourself.
panel.diag.dualHelp: Doubles the probes and the quota the check costs, but it is the only way to see which sources need the proxy.
panel.net.title: Proxy compatibility
panel.net.fakeIpHelp: If your proxy hands out fake addresses (like 198.18.x.x), keep this allowed so page text can still be fetched. No idea? Leave it as it is.
